purpose: Three deliberately different Tiny Tales productions following the Shared Harvest character-led audio correction.

global_rules.narration_visual_sync: Every spoken line and effect must begin and end inside the composition that visibly depicts it.
global_rules.sound_policy: Use real or locally synthesized effects for visible sounds; never narrate onomatopoeia as a substitute.
global_rules.motion_hierarchy: One hero action, supporting reactions, restrained ambient movement.
global_rules.camera_rule: One eased camera intent per shot; cuts land on musical phrases or visible action.
global_rules.visual_quality: Original premium colourful 3D-style 16:9 scenes with one focal point, clear depth and safe margins.

productions.title: Lina's Feelings Weather Studio | Emotional Story for Kids
story_arc: Lina opens a magical forecast studio where feelings change the room's weather.
Sunshine represents energetic joy and sharing it without overwhelming friends.
A red-orange storm represents anger; Lina pauses and takes three slow breaths.
Gentle rain represents sadness; Lina accepts comfort and asks for company.
Silver fog represents worry; Lina uses one small flashlight step at a time.
All weather becomes a rainbow as Lina learns every feeling can be noticed and guided.

productions.title: Five Little Ducks' River Countdown | Nursery Song for Kids
productions.music_policy: Use the public-domain traditional lyric premise with a new Tiny Tales arrangement, instrumentation, performance and original connecting lines.
story_arc: Five ducklings paddle from a colourful riverside nest.
One duckling at a time pauses for a visible helpful river action while the returning group counts down.
Mother Duck follows the trail rather than waiting statically.
The five ducklings reunite at a lantern-lit riverside picnic and sing the final count upward.

productions.title: Rory's Eight-Planet Postcard Adventure | Space Story for Kids
productions.accuracy_policy: Use current basic astronomy facts suitable for ages 3 to 7; keep planet order, colour, rings and broad surface type scientifically recognizable.
story_arc: Rory launches a small original postcard rocket from a backyard observatory.
Each planet receives one unique postcard tied to a visible defining feature.
Travel accelerates through the middle planets and expands into the giant outer worlds.
Rory returns home and arranges all eight postcards into a correct Sun-to-Neptune map.
